mode: round-2 independent delta re-audit of PR #1880's i18n remediation: every value that changed between a4462e721 and 79ae38539 in the edited pairs (I1 fixes plus the 8 added and 2 re-worded ui.canvas source keys), and verification that I1-1..I1-10 were applied as the round-1 audit asked

auditor.actual_model_source: session runtime header names 'Model: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5'; no fallback observed

method: Read each changed en value with its .context.json note, the before/after target value and the call sites (remote-files.ts, remote-file-transfer.tsx, attachment-frame.tsx, audio-document-player.tsx, image/video-preview.tsx, artifact-text-preview.tsx, library-card.tsx, library-download.ts, use-file-blob-url.ts); compared terms with the core glossary, the locale style guide and the existing locale catalogue; parsed and rendered every changed value with intl-messageformat (device='MacBook-Pro', name='chart.png', folder='Downloads', and the locale fallback for {device}): 0 parse errors, placeholder sets equal to en, key sets equal to en, no bidi control characters. ur values were also rendered through src/i18n/bidi.ts (isolateArguments + isolateSigils) and fribidi --rtl. No MT service used.

source_findings_not_counted.note: When page.device_name is empty, remoteDeviceFallback is spliced into remotePeerUpdateHow, rendering a non-runnable command in every locale (en: 'Run lop network update the other device on this device…'; ru also 'на устройстве другое устройство'). Fix: append the How line only when device_name is set.
